notes: Model pilot (sonnet arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole feeds the held pole bonsai1/L5/N7938- (zeroing this neuron removes 0.80 of the anchor's peak), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Kept 'phase' and synonym near misses as hard edges.
